messages.subject: Error message when installing poppr
messages.body_plain:
I'm Trying to install poppr, During installation I found an error message. R version is R 3.3.1,

> library("poppr")
Loading required package: adegenet
Loading required package: ade4
Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) :
  there is no package called ‘Rcpp’
Error: package ‘adegenet’ could not be loaded

Can you please help me.

Tanmoy Dey

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error message when installing poppr
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tanmoy,

This is not explicitly a poppr problem, but I see it commonly enough that I'm compelled to attempt to answer this in the public forum.

You could try to re-install Rcpp by using install.packages("Rcpp")

If you get an error, try deleting any file in your working directory called ".RData".

If you're using RStudio, go to tools > Global Options:
 - uncheck the box that says "Restore .RData into workspace at startup"
 - change the value of "Save workspace to .RData on exit" to "Never"

Hope that helps,
Zhian

messages.subject: minimum spanning network in imsn()
messages.body_plain:
How can I remove the number of isolates from the minimum spanning network generated by imsn()?
Thanks
messages.body_snippet:
How can I remove the number of isolates from the minimum spanning network generated by imsn()?
Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] minimum spanning network in imsn()
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm assuming you mean to remove the number displayed on the nodes? I'm afraid this currently cannot be done in imsn(), but it is possible to do in plot_poppr_msn(). If you use the imsn() function to generate the layout you want, you can go to the "Command" tab and copy + paste the code into an R script. From there, you can add the argument nodelab = 1e6 to the plot_poppr_msn() command, and the numbers should be removed. You can see the manual page for more details:

http://rpackages.ianhowson.com/cran/poppr/man/plot_poppr_msn.html

Best,
Zhian
